title: Customer Runway Signal Infusion & Deployment Scheduler
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Background: Enterprise and strategic accounts regularly trigger urgent roadmap asks via AE/CS escalations. Today those asks are handled ad hoc: CS tickets, Slack pings, and email threads. That leads to inconsistent prioritization, surprise scope, and missed SLAs for high-value customers. Goal: build a deterministic intake and auto-queueing layer that (1) synthesizes multi-source signals into a single priority score (signals: contract value, renewal horizon, severity, product impact, security/regulatory need, number of affected endpoints, customer engagement score, and executive escalation flag), (2) maps that score to a runway recommendation and suggested delivery cadence (fast-track, prioritized sprint, add-to-next-release), and (3) exposes a lightweight scheduler + approval flow for PM/Eng to accept/modify auto-queued tickets. Scope: - Ingest signals from HubSpot (deal value & renewal), Zendesk/Intercom (severity counts), NPS/CSAT feeds, and manual AE/CS escalation flags. - Produce a normalized priority score (0-100) with transparent signal weights and an explainability view in Console. - Auto-create a prioritized Linear queue lane and recommended sprint allocation (fast-track: >8 pts, priority sprint: 3-8 pts, backlog: <3 pts). - Provide an approval/override UI for PMs and Eng leads, with audit trail for decisions. Out of scope (for this ticket): implementation of cross-org SLAs enforcement, full integration with payroll or compensation, and automating contract amendments. Proposed approach: 1) Define signal model and default weights (PM-led workshop 2026-02-26). 2) Prototype scoring service (serverless microservice) that consumes normalized webhooks and runs scoring logic; expose an HTTP endpoint used by Console. 3) Add a Console panel that shows: score breakdown, recommended runway, recommended sprint/estimate bucket, and one-click 'Create prioritized Linear issue' or 'Mark for review'. 4) Linear integration: new issue template that includes score metadata and suggested estimate bucket. 5) Rollout as opt-in to a pilot group (CS + 3 Eng squads) for 6 weeks, iterate on weights and UX. Success metrics: time from escalation to triage reduces from median 14 days to <=3 days for top-tier customers; 80% of auto-queued items get reviewed within 48 hours; improved renewal sentiment on pilot customers (qualitative).
acceptance_criteria: Signal model documented with default weights and motivated rationale published to Confluence
Prototype scoring service deployed to staging and returns deterministic scores for canonical test inputs
Console panel wireframes approved by PM + Eng + CS and implemented behind feature flag
Auto-created Linear issues include score metadata and recommended estimate bucket automatically
Pilot roll-out plan with participating accounts and 6-week feedback loop scheduled
Monitoring: dashboard for queue length, time-to-review, and override rate exists and is visible to PM and GTM leaders
